findings.title: Langflow CVE-2026-5027 (CVSS 8.8) — Unpatched Path-Traversal File-Write in /api/v2/files Chains With Default Auto-Login to Unauthenticated RCE; Active Exploitation Observed Against ~7,000 Censys-Exposed Instances
findings.affected_technology: Langflow (open-source visual workflow builder for LangChain-based AI applications) up to and including 1.8.4 — the POST /api/v2/files endpoint fails to sanitize the 'filename' multipart-form parameter, allowing path-traversal arbitrary file writes; because Langflow ships with auto-login enabled by default, an unauthenticated attacker can obtain a valid session token with a single request and then write arbitrary files to disk to achieve RCE on the Langflow host; Tenable Research disclosed the issue (TRA-2026-26) on 2026-03-27 after three unanswered vendor contacts in Jan/Feb 2026; ~7,000 Langflow instances are exposed to the internet (Censys), majority in North America; active exploitation observed as of 2026-06-10 (test-file writes pre-cursor to full RCE)
findings.summary: Langflow up to 1.8.4 has an unpatched path-traversal in /api/v2/files that chains with its default auto-login posture for unauthenticated RCE — active exploitation is now observed against ~7,000 internet-exposed instances per Censys; remove Langflow from the internet, disable auto-login, and front it with a reverse proxy + strict auth immediately.

findings.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager CVE-2026-20245 — Added to CISA KEV 2026-06-09 With 13-Day Federal Deadline (Due 2026-06-23); Confirms Active Exploitation of Unpatched Root-Command-Execution Zero-Day Originally Newsed 2026-06-06
findings.affected_technology: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager (formerly vManage); originally newsed 2026-06-06 as an emergency Cisco advisory with no patch available; CISA added to KEV catalog 2026-06-09 (per news-events alert URL pattern) alongside CVE-2026-11645 Chrome V8 + CVE-2026-7473 Arista EOS, with a 13-day FCEB deadline of 2026-06-23 — KEV add formalizes active in-the-wild exploitation; still no Cisco patch as of 2026-06-11, only IOS XE / Catalyst SD-WAN Manager hardening guidance
findings.summary: CISA added Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager CVE-2026-20245 (originally Watchtower News 2026-06-06) to KEV on 2026-06-09 with a 2026-06-23 federal deadline confirming active exploitation; score up from 8 to 9 — Cisco still ships no patch, so audit every internet-reachable vManage HTTPS interface for the published mitigations today.

findings.title: Ivanti Sentry CVE-2026-10520 (CVSS 10.0) Unauthenticated Pre-Auth Root RCE + CVE-2026-10523 (CVSS 9.9) Auth-Bypass Admin Creation — Vendor Advisory + watchTowr Public PoC Both Landed 2026-06-09/10; Promoted From 2026-06-10 NOTED Now That Technical Detail Is Public
findings.affected_technology: Ivanti Sentry (mobile-gateway / MICS-config endpoint) versions 10.5.1, 10.6.1, 10.7.0 and earlier — CVE-2026-10520 is unauthenticated OS-command-injection via the /mics/api/v2/sentry/mics-config/handleMessage endpoint (commands handed straight to the backend handleExecute() routine) for trivial root RCE; CVE-2026-10523 is an authentication-bypass that lets an unauthenticated attacker create administrator accounts; Ivanti shipped fixes in Sentry 10.5.2 / 10.6.2 / 10.7.1 on 2026-06-09; watchTowr published a working PoC for CVE-2026-10520 on 2026-06-10; Ivanti has not yet seen in-wild exploitation but the PoC is trivial and Sentry has a history of CISA KEV adds (2023 multiple)
findings.summary: Ivanti Sentry CVE-2026-10520 (CVSS 10.0 unauth pre-auth root RCE) and CVE-2026-10523 (CVSS 9.9 unauth admin-account-creation) — full vendor advisory 2026-06-09 + watchTowr PoC 2026-06-10 — promoted from yesterday's NOTED entry now that technical detail is public; patch to 10.5.2 / 10.6.2 / 10.7.1 today and audit the /mics/api/v2/* path for exploitation attempts.

findings.title: Arista EOS CVE-2026-7473 (CVSS 6.9) — Tunnel-Traffic Comparison Bypass Actively Exploited and Added to CISA KEV 2026-06-09; Arista Says NO Patches Planned — ACL Workaround Only, Federal Deadline 2026-06-23
findings.affected_technology: Arista Extensible Operating System (EOS) on 7020R, 7280R / 7280R2, and 7500R / 7500R2 router series — incomplete-comparison-with-missing-factors vulnerability in tunnel-traffic processing causes EOS to forward non-configured tunnel traffic; CISA added to KEV 2026-06-09 with a 13-day FCEB deadline of 2026-06-23 confirming in-wild exploitation; Arista has formally declined to ship a patch citing configuration-compatibility risk on existing deployments and recommends ACL deployment on upstream or affected devices
findings.summary: CISA added Arista EOS CVE-2026-7473 to KEV on 2026-06-09 with a 2026-06-23 deadline confirming active exploitation, but Arista has stated NO patches will be issued — operators of 7020R / 7280R / 7500R series must deploy upstream ACLs or retire the affected devices, no fix is coming.

findings.title: Oracle PeopleSoft Mass-Extortion Campaign — ShinyHunters Claims Data Theft From 300 Instances Across 100+ Organisations Via 'Gadget Chain of Old + Zero-Day' Vulnerabilities, Education-Sector Heavy (Nottingham University Confirmed Victim)
findings.affected_technology: Oracle PeopleSoft enterprise suite (HR / payroll / finance / SCM / procurement / student administration) — ShinyHunters extortion group confirmed to BleepingComputer 2026-06-10 they breached approximately 300 PeopleSoft instances across 100+ organisations using what they describe as a 'gadget chain' of older PeopleSoft CVEs plus one or more undisclosed zero-day primitives; campaign weighted toward the education sector with many previously-extorted victims being re-targeted; Nottingham University publicly confirmed 2026-06-10 their breach with data already on the leak site; ShinyHunters has historically targeted Oracle products (April 2026 NetSuite, July 2025 SuiteCRM) and the campaign reads as an extension of that targeting cadence
findings.summary: ShinyHunters told BleepingComputer 2026-06-10 they've stolen data from 300 PeopleSoft instances across 100+ orgs (Nottingham University publicly confirmed) using a gadget-chain of old PeopleSoft CVEs + one or more zero-days — audit internet-facing PeopleSoft, ensure all 2024-2025 CPU advisories are applied, monitor for outbound data egress and exploitation attempts on PeopleSoft UI / IB endpoints.

findings.title: Microsoft Exchange Server CVE-2026-42897 OWA XSS — June 2026 Patch Tuesday Ships First Permanent Code Patch After 26 Days of Mitigations-Only Posture Following 2026-05-16 KEV Addition
findings.affected_technology: On-premises Microsoft Exchange Server 2016 / 2019 / Subscription Edition — Outlook Web Access XSS-via-crafted-email zero-day disclosed 2026-05-14 (Watchtower NEWS), KEV-added 2026-05-16 with 2026-06-06 federal deadline (Watchtower UPDATE 2026-05-17 score 9 amid mitigations-only posture); Microsoft's June 9 Patch Tuesday ships the first permanent code-level patch closing the 26-day window during which the only defence was the OWA configuration toggles Microsoft published in May; in-wild XSS-token-theft + mailbox-impersonation exploitation chain is unchanged but the patch path lowers operational pain materially for orgs that can deploy June Exchange CU rapidly
findings.summary: Microsoft Exchange Server CVE-2026-42897 OWA XSS — first permanent code patch ships in June 2026 Patch Tuesday after 26 days of mitigations-only posture (Watchtower UPDATE 2026-05-17 score 9); score down to 8 because patch is now available, deploy the June Exchange CU and remove the temporary OWA config workaround.

findings.title: Fortinet FortiSandbox CVE-2026-25089 (CVSS 9.1) — Pre-Auth OS Command Injection via 'Start VNC' Web UI JSON Parameter, Patched in 5.0.6 / 4.4.9 (FG-IR-26-141, 2026-06-09)
findings.affected_technology: Fortinet FortiSandbox 5.0.0–5.0.5, 4.4.0–4.4.8, 4.2 all versions; FortiSandbox Cloud and PaaS 5.0.4–5.0.5 — unauthenticated remote OS command injection in the Web UI 'start VNC' feature via specially-crafted JSON input causing second-order command injection (CWE-78); no auth required and attack complexity is low; FG-IR-26-141 published 2026-06-09; patched in 5.0.6, 4.4.9, Cloud 5.0.6, PaaS 5.0.6; internally discovered by Fortinet PSIRT (Adham El Karn); no observed exploitation yet but FortiSandbox sits inside enterprise security perimeters and historical Fortinet appliance disclosures see scanner-template weaponisation within days
findings.summary: Fortinet FortiSandbox CVE-2026-25089 (CVSS 9.1) — pre-auth OS command injection via the 'start VNC' Web UI JSON parameter, patched in 5.0.6 / 4.4.9 / Cloud 5.0.6 (FG-IR-26-141) — no in-wild yet but treat as 7-14 day patch SLA on perimeter security infrastructure given Fortinet's PoC-to-scanner-template tempo.
